subject: Re: Extra bus for trip days
snippet: Hi Dana, a heads-up before Monday: our rates for next summer are going up about 6 percent.
plaintext_body: Hi Dana, a heads-up before Monday: our rates for next summer are going up about 6 percent. Could you bring last summer's trip schedule to our meeting so we can plan the extra bus? Carla Mendes, Account Manager, Fernwood Coach Lines
